evals.prompt: Faz um teardown desse repo open source e mapeia o que dá pra aproveitar: github.com/example/agent-kit
evals.expected_output: Shallow clone, intake sweep, per-dimension mapping, state-check, verdicts, report with file:line evidence.
assertions: Captures the constraint rationale (why the design works FOR THEM) before judging
Each finding gets adopt / adapt / already-have / reject plus a constraint rationale for our context
Checks whether we already have the idea before recommending it

evals.prompt: Evaluate this competitor codebase for insights on architecture and testing conventions.
evals.expected_output: Maps ideas by dimension (architecture, patterns, DX, tooling, testing, docs) with verdicts.
assertions: Maps findings by dimension such as architecture, code patterns, DX, tooling, testing, docs
Produces a decision artifact, not a code tour
Rejects ideas that depend on scale or team size we do not have, with the reason

evals.prompt: Analyze the live Stripe dashboard and tell me what UX ideas we can take.
evals.expected_output: Target is a live application, which belongs to app-teardown.
assertions: Treats the work as walking live app flows
